title: LedgerEvent
description: Append-only world consequence. Players APPEND these; only the world-tick consolidates them into region state. Nobody ever edits region files directly. This is what lets multiple characters share one persistent world without write conflicts.

what.description: Short factual description, e.g. 'records_stolen: filtration purity logs taken from Radiant array office'

worldDay.description: absolute world day, shared across every device

impactsLocal.description: SNG-041/145: crosses into another player's area, so it waits in escrow for a confirm

people.description: ⛔ CCODE-461: WHO THE ROW IS ABOUT, as a key rather than as prose. The reader on the other side is keyed by person; before this, no row carried one. Derived at the writer from the author's own npcRegistry.

why.description: named = the prose says so; present = they were merely in the scene, which is weaker and labelled so a reader can weigh it

_note: ⚠️ NOTHING READS THIS FILE. The effective validator is the field allowlist in app.js where a row is built (two places: the turn's `ledgerEvents` and a quest ending's `recordLedger`), and a field absent from THAT is dropped in silence whatever this says. Kept accurate as documentation — it drifted before (no `worldDay`, no `impactsLocal`, and a `visibility` enum missing two of the values in live rows). CCODE-461.
